metadata.title: Michigan Unclaimed Property - This is How You Make an Unclaimed Property Claim
metadata.author: Michael Curtis
metadata.shortDescription:
In this video you'll learn how to file an unclaimed property claim with the state of Michigan. There is currently over $950,000,000 in unclaimed property waiting to be claimed. Not from Michigan? https://forgottenloot.org

The state treasure department serves as custodial and would like to turn the money, property to the rightful owners. But before that can happen, you have to  submit a claim.

This video will guide you through the process. If you're not from Michigan, find out about your state over on my website https://forgottenloot.org

Michigan official unclaimed funds search website: https://unclaimedproperty.michigan.gov/
keywords: how to search for unclaimed money Michigan
